summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Brazilian Material Fact disclosure) reporting that on September 17, 2026 its Board of Directors approved the cancellation of 13,200,000 treasury shares, without reduction of capital stock, acquired under Buyback Program 8 approved February 12, 2025. Post-cancellation capital comprises 2,378,925,889 common shares. Article 5 of the bylaws will be adjusted at the next shareholders' meeting. No price or premium is stated. Watch for the EGM bylaw amendment and potential EPS accretion from the roughly 0.55% share-count reduction.
